shortDescription: Taiwan's Wistron Corp TWSE:3231 has launched an offering of 25 million global depositary shares, or GDSs, worth up to $1.48 billion, to fund purchases of raw materials in foreign currencies, according to a term sheet seen by Reuters on Monday.
